description: The agent must read SKILL.md carefully and produce two PowerShell scripts. For `daily-backup.ps1`: set `$WorkspacePath = '/workspace/ai_workspace'`, `$BackupDir = '/workspace/backups_dir'`, `$MirrorPath = '/workspace/mirror_drive'`, and `$RetentionDays = 7` (the exact documented default — not 14, not 30). The script must create timestamped zips named `backup-YYYY-MM-DD.zip`, include retention logic that deletes backups older than 7 days using `Remove-Item` with a date comparison, and mirror to the secondary drive using `robocopy ... /MIR` (not rsync or cp). For `register-task.ps1`: must use `New-ScheduledTaskAction`, `New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Daily -At 3AM` (3AM specifically — a common trap is using midnight or 2AM), `Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'AI Workspace Backup'` (exact name — not 'BackupJob' or similar), and reference `daily-backup.ps1` as the executed script. The key discriminative traps are: (1) the retention value of exactly 7, (2) the task name string 'AI Workspace Backup', (3) the 3AM trigger time, (4) robocopy /MIR for mirroring, and (5) the zip naming convention from the restore procedure in the docs.
